  "memo":"R03 holds: the Spanish-issued card is used from a Canadian IP and address verification failed. Card is the sole adverse family; no other rule condition holds. Device and address linkage thresholds are not met, so household exceptions are unnecessary. No earlier outcome settles the order, and no check has run. A legitimate foreign-card purchase is plausible given the established device, home delivery and matching CVV, but those facts do not establish card ownership. Under FP-2 §6.6(b), recommend needs_check, implemented by the analyst as a hold with id_check. A single family does not permit decline, and escalation is prohibited. The order is unshipped; issuer authentication and identity verification are the required, decision-changing next check."
